column1: # Starter map from generator names to decoder families, for
# scripts/group-manifest.py (which writes the family into manifest column 8)
# and, resolved to exact names with --write-map, for `tintype train
# Tab-separated: generator glob, dataset glob, family, basis, note. Matching
# ignores case; the first row that matches wins; a generator that matches no
# row is `unknown`. Real items are not mapped (their family column stays
# Basis says what an assignment rests on:
#   name         the name itself states the family
#   dataset-doc  the dataset's own documentation states it
#   model-doc    the model's paper or model card, as recalled when this file
#                was written; not looked up again. Confirm before relying on
#                a row for a hold-out or a report slice
#   closed       a closed commercial service: family commercial-unknown
#   none         nothing to go on: family unknown
# This is a proposal for the maintainer to correct, not a record of fact.
